name: The 10/20/30 Venture Pattern
axiom: Ten slides, twenty minutes, thirty-point type: the constraint is the argument.
trigger: Formal venture partner meetings, where attention is short and the room has read a hundred decks that month.

steps.text: Ten slides: one idea each, no appendix crutches.
Twenty minutes: leave the rest of the hour for questions.
Thirty-point type: if it will not fit, it is not the pitch.

antiPattern.violation: A forty-slide deck read aloud at speed, which proves the presenter can fill time and not that the idea survives compression.
antiPattern.remediation: Cut to ten slides and move the detail to the appendix. The constraint is a test of the argument, not a style rule.
